title: Addition

copy.studentInstructions: Add the two numbers. Tap the answer under the matching letter. Tap again to unmark. Complete the winning pattern shown below, then press Call MATHO!
copy.roomIntro: Students join with a room code and a display name. Each gets a different board with a free center square. Answers get bigger from M to O. Choose the winning pattern below.
copy.roomHeading: Little sums. A whole lot of fun.
copy.callerSubtitle: Add the numbers. Find your answer. Call MATHO!
copy.joinIntro: Get the code from your teacher. Let’s add!
copy.footer: Add it up. Find your square.
copy.bankIntro: Every number being added is between 0 and 15. Answers run from 0 to 30. Each letter has its own answer range: M 0–5, A 6–11, T 12–17, H 18–23, O 24–30. Changes save on this browser; start a new game to edit questions already called.

caller.default: Add the numbers. Find your answer in column {letter}.

student.default: Add the numbers and check column {letter}.

presentationSubtitle: Match the letter. Add the numbers. Mark your answer.
